items.description:
Melitha Consultants is an accounting practice in Eloffsdal built on the idea, from 2011, that a business needs structure not just in its books but across the company as a whole. Its service offering covers a full range of accounting work beyond simple bookkeeping, including payroll and tax, extending from full-function bookkeeping and balance sheet reconciliation through to broader financial administration, with accreditation through SAIBA as a registered Business Accountant in Practice and as a SARS Tax Practitioner.

The practice assists both large entities and smaller firms, drawing on experience across engineering and manufacturing companies, retail and property-letting businesses, and doctor and dentist practices, as well as individuals based locally and abroad. Operating from Eloff Street in Eloffsdal, Melitha Consultants suits clients who want one firm handling the full financial picture rather than piecing services together.

Middel & Partners has helped build and grow businesses across South Africa since 1992, working as chartered accountants and auditors across countless industries and specialities. The firm positions itself less as a traditional auditor and more as a co-pilot for its clients' businesses, guiding strategy, innovation and growth through digital transformation, financial distress and company reviews, backed by a network of nine national offices that share professional skills, resources and experience.

With more than a thousand clients built up over three decades, the practice draws on a broad base of audit, advisory, accounting and business model innovation work to support companies of varying size and complexity. From its office in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, Middel & Partners is suited to businesses wanting an accounting partner involved in long-term strategy rather than only compliance.

Mind Haven Innovations is the company behind LifeLink, a privacy-preserving community safety and missing-persons response network based in Clubview, Centurion. The platform is built around rapid neighbourhood alerts: when a child wanders off or an elderly relative with memory loss goes missing, verified neighbours and the company's 24/7 Care Room are mobilised within minutes, without strangers ever seeing a family's phone number, surname or home address.

Run by a women-owned team and operating under POPIA and PAIA compliance, Mind Haven Innovations is part of the wider Horizon Strategic Group, with its underlying technology licensed through VaultCore Solutions. It offers several membership tiers from a free option to paid plans, plus community guardians who help coordinate local response, suiting Clubview-area families wanting an alternative to traditional alarm systems built specifically around locating missing loved ones quickly.

Mont Paradiso Guesthouse is a 4-star graded guesthouse set within the Magalies Nature Reserve in Waverley, with en-suite rooms featuring air conditioning, Wi-Fi and satellite TV, backed by room service and dinner available on request. Guests can make use of an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant and dining area, a jacuzzi, and hiking and walking trails through the reserve, while dedicated conference and wedding facilities extend the property beyond simple overnight stays.

The guesthouse suits business travellers, leisure guests, honeymoon couples and families, as well as groups organising a conference, wedding or similar event on site, and has built up a strong run of positive guest reviews over time. Based at 1246 Breyer Avenue in Waverley, Pretoria, Mont Paradiso gives visitors the feel of a nature-reserve retreat without giving up the comforts of a full-service guesthouse.

Mooiplaats Landfill Disposal Recycling Site is operated by The Waste Group, a waste management and recycling company with branches across Gauteng, North West, Mpumalanga, Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal. The group runs two private landfill sites in Gauteng, offering safe, sustainable landfill services to clients of all sizes, and has built its reputation on holistic, environmentally friendly and economically viable waste management solutions, earning a number of industry awards along the way.

Looking ahead, the company plans to develop South Africa's first so-called Waste City at the Mooiplaats site, a project intended to address all facets and levels of waste management and extend the site's service life by around 60 years. Located near Knoppieslaagte, Blue Valley Golf Estate in Centurion, the Mooiplaats site serves municipalities, businesses and other clients across the province needing dependable, long-term waste disposal capacity.

Moot Security Shop, in Villieria, Pretoria, is part of the Security Shop Group, supplying and supporting a full range of security equipment including gate automation, electric fencing, CCTV cameras, alarms and access control systems, along with garage door motors, batteries, cables and related accessories. The shop offers nationwide delivery and trades on established, trusted brands, backing its products with ongoing technical support.

Customer feedback highlights the shop's after-sales service, with reviewers describing staff going out of their way to help diagnose and repair faulty gate motors and damaged power coils, including guiding customers through fixes over the phone and by video call. Based in Villieria, Moot Security Shop suits homeowners and businesses across the Moot area needing both new security installations and ongoing repairs and support for existing systems.

Murrayfield Tax Consulting provides tax and accounting-related services from its base in Murrayfield, Pretoria, with a current offering centred on VAT-registered shelf companies, company-registration packages and related tax and company-formation work. This gives clients a route to a ready, VAT-registered entity or a newly registered company without having to manage the formation process themselves from scratch.

The practice serves businesses and individual clients needing tax, company-registration and accounting-related assistance, and is also currently listed as a bookkeeping service alongside its tax work. Based at 362 Rossouw Street in Murrayfield, Pretoria, Murrayfield Tax Consulting suits new and established businesses wanting one local practice to handle company registration, VAT status and the ongoing tax and bookkeeping side of running a company.

MyBI (Pty) Ltd develops business-intelligence and financial-management applications that integrate with Sage 50cloud, Sage Pastel Partner, Pastel Xpress and Sage 200/Evolution, turning accounting data already held in those systems into management accounts, dashboards, VAT reconciliations and consolidated reporting. Its tools extend into budgeting and forecasting, sales and customer management, and procurement and supplier management, aimed at giving business owners a fuller view of their finances than the base accounting package alone provides.

The company serves business owners, financial managers, accountants, auditors and other organisations already running their books on Sage or Pastel, rather than replacing those systems outright. Registered as MyBI (Pty) Ltd, registration 2017/511046/07, and based at 483 Oregon Street in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, MyBI is classified as both a software company and a business-management consultant, suiting clients wanting more from their existing accounting data.

N2 Steel Works is a steel construction and engineering company based in Waltloo, Pretoria, founded in 2017 to provide tailored, one-of-a-kind steel solutions for companies of all sizes. Its work spans structural steel for cranes, gantry designs and residential projects, with one featured residence, recognised at the SAISC Steel Awards, using an exposed steel structure to open up large glazed areas and contrast curved brickwork with sculptural concrete elements.

The company has built relationships with several affiliated businesses in construction and related trades, reflecting a project-based way of working that brings in specialist partners as needed. Operating from Mundt Street in Waltloo, N2 Steel Works suits developers and homeowners looking for a steel contractor comfortable combining structural engineering with a more architectural, design-led approach to residential and commercial builds.

NAKO Group is an African-owned and operated group of consulting engineering firms, comprising subsidiaries including NAKO TRICON, NAKO LBE and NAKO ILLISO, each established and well-regarded within its own field of operation. The group shares a founding ethos built around long-term presence in the countries and cities where it works, engineering excellence, and investment in developing local expertise and value-adding partnerships, rather than operating as a fly-in consultancy.

Headquartered at Highveld Techno Park in Eco Park, Centurion, with a resource base extending across the country and into other parts of Africa, NAKO Group focuses its engineering milestones and projects on the sustainable development of the continent. The group suits public and private sector clients needing multi-disciplinary consulting engineering delivered by teams with deep, long-standing roots in the regions they serve.

Nnovative Automation is an industrial automation and systems integration company based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, founded in 2014 and grown from a small garage-based operation into a respected name in South African manufacturing automation. Its multi-disciplinary engineering team now works from dedicated workshop facilities, combining industrial automation engineering qualifications with hands-on mechanical automation experience to take projects from initial concept through to final commissioning.

The company serves a wide spread of industries, including automotive, mining, aerospace, military, and food and beverage, reflecting the breadth of automation challenges it has taken on since its early days. Based in Rooihuiskraal and open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm, Nnovative Automation suits manufacturers needing equipment refurbishment, control system programming or full automation systems designed around their specific production line.

Oasis Water Centurion | Celtis Ridge is a branch of the Oasis Water franchise network, which spans more than 150 stores, trading from Shop 9 in the Celtis Ridge Shopping Centre at the corner of Ruimte and Seedcracker Streets. Like other Oasis Water outlets, the store purifies and ozonates its drinking water on site, giving customers a locally bottled alternative to tap water along with dispenser rental and repair support.

Customer reviews point to attentive, hands-on service, with staff helping diagnose and resolve problems with water dispensers and guiding customers by phone when something goes wrong. Serving the Celtisdal and wider Centurion area, this Oasis Water branch suits households and offices wanting a nearby, reliable source of purified water along with straightforward support when equipment needs attention.

items.description:
Organisation Development International (ODI) is a productivity and management consulting company based in Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, working with organisations to improve the productivity of their people, processes and technology. Its best-known offering, the 20 Keys programme, follows a philosophy of making operations better, faster and more cost-effective, delivered through consulting, coaching and training built around continuous operations improvement.

ODI is accredited to offer qualifications, learnerships and skills programmes through Services Seta, merSETA and SABPP, and runs its own ODI E-Learning Academy alongside short courses designed to meet specific company needs and support continuing professional development. Based in Highveld, Centurion, the company suits organisations wanting a structured, accredited route to improving operational performance rather than a one-off training intervention.

Pendio Valuers is a property valuation firm in Erasmuskloof, staffed by members of the South African Institute of Valuers who can provide services and assistance on short notice. Its property inspection work spans residential properties such as townhouses, flats, bachelor apartments, government and retirement housing, and estates, advising private, financial, legal and governmental clients, as well as retail and industrial property including shops, shopping centres, warehouses, cold rooms, dairies and abattoirs.

The firm also values agricultural property, drawing on experience with small holdings, cattle and game farms, vineyards, crops, poultry and other farms, in addition to insolvent and deceased estates. Operating from Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, Pendio Valuers suits property owners, investors, attorneys and institutions needing a qualified, independent valuation across almost any property type, from a single flat to an agricultural operation.

Piccola Italia is a traditional Italian restaurant at Monument Park Shopping Centre, built around a wood-fired pizza oven and a kitchen that prides itself on simple, well-executed pasta alongside its pizzas. Alongside its regular menu, the restaurant runs a TAPAS menu for guests wanting to share smaller plates, and has drawn praise from diners describing it as a hidden gem with some of the best pasta and pizza in town.

The restaurant offers deliveries and catering in addition to dine-in service, with outdoor pavement seating for guests who prefer to eat al fresco. Based at Skilpad Road in Monument Park, Pretoria, Piccola Italia suits anyone after an unpretentious, traditional Italian meal rather than a fine-dining experience, with reservations recommended on busy evenings.

PM Attorneys is a law firm based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, practising across conveyancing and property law, commercial and corporate law, and family law. Its family law work covers antenuptial and postnuptial contracts, customary and polygamous marriages, divorce and family disputes, and maintenance and custody matters, while its property side handles the legal transfer and registration work that comes with buying and selling real estate.

The firm also handles personal injury claims and Road Accident Fund matters, publishing detailed guidance on RAF claim documents, time limits and how much claimants can recover, reflecting a practical, client-facing approach to a complex area of law. Based in Centurion, PM Attorneys suits both property buyers and sellers needing conveyancing support and individuals pursuing personal injury or RAF claims after an accident.

Porsche Centre Pretoria, on Botterklapper Street in Die Wilgers, is an authorised dealership within the Porsche South Africa network, a brand that has had an official presence in the country since 1952. As one of only a handful of Porsche Centres nationally, alongside those in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Umhlanga, the Pretoria centre gives Gauteng customers full access to new and pre-owned Porsche sales along with Porsche Tequipment accessories and merchandise.

The dealership's reach extends well beyond Pretoria, supporting customers travelling from as far afield as Mbombela, Middelburg, Witbank, Secunda, Polokwane and Rustenburg who want the backing of an official Porsche Centre. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 1pm, Porsche Centre Pretoria suits owners and prospective buyers wanting factory-backed sales and service for the brand in the region.

Porter and Connections, trading as PConnect Management Systems, is a Pretoria-based consultancy established in 2019 that develops, implements and maintains ISO and other management systems for organisations across South Africa. Its ISO work covers quality, environmental, occupational health and safety, food safety, information security, medical-device and energy management systems, certified under ISO 9001:2015 by ISOQAR, with professionals registered through SAIOSH and SACPCMP.

Beyond ISO certification support, the company runs dedicated occupational health and safety and construction health and safety services, including legal compliance audits, risk management and ongoing retainer support aligned with South African requirements. Based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, PConnect suits organisations that need a management system built around their actual operations and risks, then kept current through ongoing support.

Powerbuild Doornpoort is a hardware and building-materials supplier trading from the Doornpark Shopping Centre, currently categorised for building materials, electrical supplies and garden products alongside gas cylinders, glass cutting, key duplication, paint, plumbing supplies and tools. That spread of categories gives it a broad, general-hardware role rather than a single specialism, covering much of what a home-improvement project or repair might call for in one visit.

The store serves homeowners, DIY customers, contractors, tradespeople and other customers needing hardware, building and home-improvement supplies, and has built up a strong rating from a large number of customer reviews. Based at Shop 17, Doornpark Shopping Centre, 487 Airport Road in Doornpoort, Pretoria, Powerbuild Doornpoort suits anyone from a homeowner tackling a weekend repair to a tradesperson restocking supplies for a job.

Profection Manufacturers, trading as Profection Enterprise, provides precision engineering and manufacturing services spanning engineering design and prototype development through to fibre-laser cutting, fabrication, CNC bending, welding, assembly, and punching and pressing. Its finishing capabilities cover powder coating, E-coating and sandblasting, while its cutting and forming side extends to tube laser cutting and CNC press-brake work, giving it a full run from initial design to a finished, coated component.

The company serves engineering and manufacturing customers across the automotive, energy, mining, defence, telecommunications, construction, medical and commercial sectors, reflecting a broad industrial customer base built up over time. Based at 110 Foundry Street, Pretoria, Profection states it has operated in the industry since 1989, holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and Level 2 B-BBEE status, suiting manufacturers needing a single contractor across design, fabrication and finishing.

Pure Joy Guest Lodge is a TGCSA 4-star graded exclusive lodge and conference venue in Kameeldrift East, affiliated with the AA and NAA, offering a one-stop package of venue, décor, catering and accommodation rather than requiring guests to coordinate separate suppliers. Just minutes from Pretoria yet set in a secure, peaceful bushveld setting, it positions itself as suited to both work and celebration.

The lodge accommodates groups from a minimum of 10 up to 120 guests, and hosts a wide range of events including conferences, weddings, team-building days, school leadership camps and church camps, with custom packages built for businesses, schools, churches, families and couples. Based in Kameeldrift East, Pure Joy Guest Lodge suits organisations and families wanting a single venue that can handle both the practical logistics and the atmosphere of a bushveld setting.

Raft Crete is a raft foundation construction specialist established in 2003 and based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, best known for its patented waffle raft foundation system, developed and tested with leading engineering firms. The company has since completed more than two million square metres of raft foundation projects, built around its own earthworks, raft design and Chelle Systems insulated concrete floor offerings.

Its staff carry an average of 15 years' experience, and the company has built strong, ongoing relationships with engineers and developers across the industry, serving developers, consulting engineers and private homebuilders who need raft foundations on both problematic and non-problematic soils. Operating mainly across Gauteng from its Sunderland Ridge base, Raft Crete suits projects where a tested, scalable foundation system matters more than a one-off custom design.

items.reason: Confirmed only as a business-management consulting company at 755 Killick Avenue, Mayville, Pretoria 0084; the detailed facilities-management service list (plumbing, electrical work, irrigation and landscaping, and air conditioning) in the current description could not be independently verified from any available source. Held pending verification of the specific service offering.

items.description:
REAM Insurance Brokers, based in Waterkloof Glen, has operated as a registered Financial Services Provider since 1988, structuring tailored commercial and industrial insurance alongside a set of niche products built for specific client needs. Its TUFFSTUFF product covers 4x4 owners travelling throughout Africa south of the equator, while TOPMARQ is built around domestic buildings, contents and private motor cover for homeowners.

The brokerage also arranges Precious Metal insurance for classic cars, Yellow Metal cover for earthmoving and other heavy machinery, and Contract Works insurance for building renovations, domestic construction, shopping malls, multi-storey structures and road works, alongside broader commercial and industrial policies. Based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, REAM Insurance Brokers suits both private clients with a specific asset to protect and businesses needing more conventional commercial and industrial cover.

Redbean Projects & Signage is a Gauteng-based signage business that has been turning branding into physical signage since 2009, now with more than 20 years of combined experience in branding, signage and project delivery. Its work covers 3D signs, illuminated channel letters, building and pylon signage, lightboxes and internal and corporate signage, designed and manufactured in-house before being installed by its own experienced team.

Rather than simply supplying a sign, the company works with clients to develop the artwork and signage concept, source the right production solution, and manage the project through to installation, considering site access, mounting requirements and the surrounding environment along the way. Based in Centurion, Redbean Projects & Signage suits businesses across Gauteng wanting a single point of contact from concept through to a securely fitted, correctly aligned sign.

Francois Kretsman is a rental agent with RE/MAX Infoglobe who has specialised in tenant placement and rental management across Pretoria East for more than 13 years, working with landlords in Garsfontein, Moreletapark, Faerie Glen and the surrounding suburbs. His service is built specifically around landlords struggling to find reliable tenants, covering tenant screening, lease agreements, marketing and a fast turnaround from listing to occupancy.

Kretsman works with a limited number of landlords at a time, aiming to avoid the vacant properties, bad tenants, late payments and wasted viewing time that come with a less hands-on approach to letting. Operating across Pretoria East under the RE/MAX brand, this rental agent suits landlords who want ongoing, personal management of their rental property rather than a once-off introduction to a tenant.

RH Trading began in 2002 as a retail IT company and has since evolved into a dedicated supplier of IT products, services and support for small and medium enterprises in Doornpoort and the wider Pretoria area. Its computer-repair team carries more than 20 years of combined experience, which the company draws on to deliver courteous, efficient service aimed at resolving IT problems quickly.

The business prioritises personalised, high-quality service over volume, positioning itself as a dedicated SME partner rather than a general electronics retailer. Based in Doornpoort and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, RH Trading suits small and medium businesses that need a consistent IT supplier for hardware, support and repairs without the overhead of an in-house IT department.

Rocky Ridge Events is a function and party venue in Kameeldrift East, a few kilometres from Roodeplaat Dam, offering four distinct venues alongside a Fantasy Mini-Town play area for children. Each venue has its own character, from the rock-ringed Klipkoppie Lapa suited to weddings and corporate events to the Mini-Town Lapa set inside the play area itself, with every venue including braai facilities and access to jungle gyms.

The venue caters for birthdays, weddings, kitchen and stork teas, corporate functions and graduations, and can be booked self-catering or with décor, catering and cleaning handled by the venue itself. Based at Mooipoort Street in Kameeldrift East and bookable by phone or WhatsApp from 8am to 5pm, Rocky Ridge Events suits families and companies wanting a bushveld setting where children are entertained while adults celebrate.

Rolec Electrical & Generators Contractors has supplied and installed generators across South Africa since 2009, working with established brands including Volvo, Perkins and John Deere to cover everything from small 15kVA units to robust 2500kVA systems. The Derdepoort-based company also carries out safety inspections and audits aligned with health and safety regulations and insurers' requirements, backed by certified electricians and generator technicians registered with the Department of Labour and ECBSA.

The business has built its reputation on productivity, workmanship and dependability, prioritising customer service and high-quality work on every project it takes on. Operating from Bergzicht Road in Derdepoort and open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm, Rolec suits homes, businesses and institutions needing a generator sized to their specific backup power requirements, installed and maintained by qualified, registered electricians.

Sable Hills Lodge offers self-catering accommodation inside the gated Sable Hills Waterfront Estate, just outside Pretoria, with apartments comfortably sleeping four adults and five units able to take two additional children on a sleeper couch. Every unit has two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchenette, a lounge and dining area opening onto a private balcony or stoep with braai facilities, plus a television with Netflix and YouTube.

Guests have access to a fully equipped gymnasium, self-drive game viewing with their own vehicle, beach volleyball, an Olympic-size swimming pool, a kiddies' pool and play area, walking trails, mountain bike routes and birdwatching on the estate. Rates run from around R1,100 per person a night including breakfast. Based in Pretoria, Sable Hills Lodge suits families and groups wanting a self-catering base with resort-style facilities rather than a serviced hotel stay.

SECE provides business compliance services built around employment-equity compliance, skills-development work and skills-plan submissions, COIDA registration and related compliance support for South African employers. Alongside this core offering, the company runs training and assists businesses with SDL and B-BBEE-related compliance, covering several of the recurring regulatory obligations a growing company has to manage each year.

SECE serves businesses needing employment-equity, skills-development, COIDA and related regulatory-compliance assistance, acting as an outside compliance partner rather than requiring a company to build that expertise in-house. Based at 601 Joseph Bosman Street in Silverton, Pretoria, SECE suits employers wanting one practice to handle equity, skills-development and COIDA compliance together rather than dealing with each requirement through a separate provider.

Senses Beauty & Spa, in Erasmia, offers a broad range of beauty and spa treatments including facials, massages, waxing, manicures and pedicures, lash and brow treatments, and body piercing, alongside more advanced options such as Ellipse IPL hair removal and Dermapen 4 micro-needling. Alongside its German-made BABOR skincare range, the salon stocks other reputable local and international beauty brands for clients wanting to continue their treatment results at home.

Beyond individual treatments, Senses also runs its own training courses, including a facials course, a Dermapen 4 micro-needling course, and massage and reflexology courses, reflecting an operation that trains as well as treats. Based in Erasmia, Pretoria, Senses Beauty & Spa suits clients looking for a single salon that covers everyday beauty maintenance and more specialised skin and body treatments under one roof.

Silver Star Laser Engraving and Cutting is a specialist laser-cutting service based in Dorandia, Pretoria North, offering precision cutting work to customers who need a specific shape, pattern or component cut rather than a general metalworking job handled under one roof. Its focus on laser cutting as a dedicated service, rather than one of several unrelated trades, points to equipment and expertise built specifically around that single process.

The business serves customers requiring laser-cutting or engraving services, from individuals with a one-off job to businesses needing cut components on a more regular, ongoing basis. Based at 796 Riana Street in Dorandia, Pretoria North, Silver Star Laser Engraving and Cutting suits anyone needing precise, repeatable laser-cut work without having to go through a larger, general fabrication shop.

Soft-Ice Catering Equipment is a commercial catering equipment supplier based in Montana, Pretoria, trading since 2008 and serving as the exclusive South African importer for the ChromeCater and Beiqi brands. Its online shop stocks spiral inverter mixers in several sizes, soft-serve and slush machines, commercial refrigeration, and butchery items including replacement blades for band saws, alongside combo deals aimed at businesses setting up or upgrading a kitchen.

The company also deals in cup and can sealers and related consumables such as clear plastic cups, giving restaurants and caterers a single supplier for both equipment and ongoing consumables. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to midday, Soft-Ice Catering Equipment suits restaurants, caterers and butcheries in and around Pretoria needing reliable commercial kitchen equipment backed by layby and delivery options.

Solar & Security Nerd supplies solar-energy, backup-power, electrical and security products from its base on the corner of Paul Kruger and Fred Nicholson Street in Mayville, Pretoria, with a range that covers solar panels, batteries, hybrid inverters and solar geyser equipment. Its stock extends into electrical cable and related electrical products, alongside solar installation and maintenance services for customers wanting a system fitted and kept running rather than just supplied in a box.

The business serves homeowners and businesses needing solar power, backup-energy, electrical or security solutions, reflecting the overlap between energy backup and basic security that many South African properties now need addressed together. Based in Mayville, Pretoria, Solar & Security Nerd suits customers wanting one supplier for solar equipment, electrical products and installation rather than sourcing each separately.

SPAR Les Marais is a supermarket and grocery retailer offering fresh groceries, fruit and vegetables, prepared foods and deli products, with a salad bar for customers after a ready-to-eat option and same-day delivery for those who would rather shop from home. That combination of fresh produce, a deli counter and delivery gives it a role covering both the everyday grocery run and a quicker meal solution for busy households.

The store serves local households and consumers shopping for groceries, fresh produce and prepared foods in the Les Marais area of Pretoria. Based at 662 Paul Kruger Street and trading daily from 08:00 to 20:00, SPAR Les Marais suits shoppers wanting a full grocery range along with fresher, ready-made options close to home.

Stallion Turbos is a turbocharger specialist in Dorandia with more than 33 years in the trade, having rebuilt over 65,000 turbochargers to OEM specification and backed every rebuild with a 12-month guarantee. The business covers turbochargers for more than 574 vehicle models across major makes including Toyota, Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volvo, Ford, Nissan, Isuzu and Land Rover, offering both repairs and new units.

Its services extend from turbo repair and OEM-spec reconditioning to performance upgrades and failure-analysis diagnostics, supported by a free strip-and-quote service and same-day turnaround where possible. Based in Dorandia, Pretoria, Stallion Turbos suits motorists and workshops needing a specialist that can diagnose a turbo problem accurately rather than simply replacing the unit, with select models kept in stock for faster turnaround.

Storage Pretoria East is a self-storage facility in Willow Park Manor with more than 300 brick-and-mortar units across three sizes, each with a roll-up garage door. The units are insulated under the roof sheeting, keeping them cool in summer and warm in winter, with the smallest size suited to the contents of a two-bedroom flat and the largest able to hold a big house's belongings or a caravan and boat.

Customers have described the service as friendly and helpful, and the facility offers free, no-obligation quotations for anyone unsure which unit size they need. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria East, Storage Pretoria East suits households between moves, businesses needing overflow space, and anyone storing a caravan, boat or other large item that does not fit comfortably at home.

System Design Experts, trading from Zwartkop in Centurion, supplies and installs ICASA-approved cell phone signal boosters under brands including Amplitec and ConnectMobile, covering all major South African mobile networks. Its range is built around where the signal is needed, from small home and office kits through to large home and office, farm and lodge, vehicle, and mines and industry boosters, each suited to a different building size and signal problem.

Alongside signal boosters, the company runs a video surveillance division, giving it a second line of business in building security systems. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, System Design Experts suits households, farms, lodges and industrial or mining sites struggling with poor cellular reception, offering guidance on the right booster for a specific property rather than a single generic product.

Techfusion (Pty) Ltd provides IT managed services and digital-transformation consulting, helping businesses manage IT infrastructure, support and security without running that function entirely in-house. Healthcare and logistics are identified as particular focus industries, reflecting sectors where secure, dependable IT infrastructure and uptime matter especially heavily to day-to-day operations.

The company serves businesses and organisations needing managed IT services, digital transformation and secure IT infrastructure, particularly in healthcare and logistics, and works with more than 150 clients across Africa. Founded in 2003 in Pretoria and based at Fintech Campus, Block B, on the corner of Botterklapper Street and Ilanga Road in The Willows, Techfusion suits organisations wanting an established IT partner rather than building a full internal IT department.

Thai Summit Autoparts Industry South Africa is a subsidiary of Thailand's Thai Summit Group, a company with more than 40 years of experience as a leading automotive parts manufacturer across Asia and beyond. From its facility in the Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone, in The Willows, the company manufactures body-in-white components, chassis parts, body systems, welded assemblies and deep-draw stampings for the automotive sector.

As a NAACAM member holding a Level 4 B-BBEE rating, the company operates as part of the formal supply chain feeding South Africa's automotive manufacturing industry, bringing Asian manufacturing experience into a local production setting. Based in the Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone, Thai Summit Autoparts suits vehicle manufacturers and other automotive companies in the zone needing an established, process-driven supplier of pressed and welded body components.

The Fabric Warehouse, in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, stocks a wide range of fabrics including several types of fleece, from coral and minky to Mongolian, polar and Sherpa fleece, alongside printed coral velour for crafting and home projects. Its dress fabric range covers bridal wear, casual wear and evening wear, complemented by sewing machines and equipment for customers who sew their own garments and décor pieces.

Operating since 1994, the business has built a loyal following among home sewers, small manufacturers and crafters needing a single supplier for both fabric and the equipment to work it. Based on Van Tonder Street in Sunderland Ridge, The Fabric Warehouse suits anyone from a bride planning her own gown to a hobbyist crafting curtains or cushions, with nationwide delivery for customers outside Centurion.

items.reason: Confirmed as a geospatial/spatial-data technology company (Spatial Data Platform for 3D digital-twin and asset-monitoring work, plus hydro, tailings-management, surveying, geospatial and data-management consulting), but the company's own current official contact page gives its head office as 30 Alexandra Road, Queens Office Park, Building 2, Irene, Centurion 0157 -- not the 20 Impala Avenue, Doringkloof, Centurion 0157 address on this listing. Held pending resolution of this address conflict; do not publish a description tied to the Doringkloof address.

items.description:
The IV Bar, in Hazeldean Retail Square, offers intravenous vitamin therapy administered by registered nurses in a serene, comfortable lounge setting designed to put even needle-wary clients at ease. Its menu of customised infusions includes drips aimed at immunity boosting, anti-inflammatory support, detoxing, energy boosting, fertility support, hangover and jet lag recovery, and menopause support, each formulated for a specific outcome rather than a single generic vitamin mix.

Client safety and hygiene are treated as central to the service, with every infusion designed to deliver full nutrient absorption in a way oral supplements cannot match. Based at Silver Lakes and Hazeldean Retail Square in Pretoria East, The IV Bar suits clients looking to recover from illness, a heavy workout or a big weekend, as well as anyone wanting a more targeted approach to energy, skin or overall wellness.

The Play Date is a self-catering kiddies' outdoor play and party venue in Monavoni, Centurion, built around jungle gyms, treehouses and slides that let children play freely while adults enjoy a picnic or braai nearby. The venue is Halal and Kosher friendly, and families are welcome to bring their own food and drinks or arrange their own caterer rather than being tied to an in-house kitchen.

Two venues are available for hire, including the dedicated Play Date venue and the adjoining Save The Date venue for larger celebrations, both offered on a self-catering basis alongside simple per-child entry for families just visiting to play. Based at Louise Road in Monavoni, with viewing by appointment on weekdays, The Play Date suits birthday parties and casual family outings alike.

The Real Food Co. Catering & Events has provided corporate and private catering across Centurion, Pretoria, Midrand and Johannesburg since 2014, building its reputation on food that is fresh, well-presented and consistent rather than mass-produced. Its corporate offering covers executive breakfasts, working lunches and meetings, company training lunches and seminars, and individually pre-packed daily office meals for businesses that want staff fed without the hassle of catering logistics.

For private clients, the company puts together platters, buffets and tailored menus for events such as birthdays and weddings, and can also supply cutlery, crockery, beverages, glassware, décor, flowers and additional staff on request. Based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, The Real Food Co. suits businesses needing regular, dependable office catering as much as hosts planning a one-off private celebration.

Tileba Vleismark is a family-operated butchery supplying fresh beef, lamb, pork and chicken, alongside steaks, boerewors, droewors, biltong, prepared cuts and braai packages for customers planning anything from a weeknight meal to a weekend braai. Custom cuts, wholesale pricing and game processing round out the offering for buyers with more specific or larger-volume needs.

The butchery serves households and individual shoppers, as well as restaurants, lodges and larger functions needing wholesale meat or braai supplies, and trades Monday to Friday from 7am to 6pm and Saturdays until 2pm. Based at Shop 1, Shop Centre, 3 Wouter Street in Tileba, Pretoria, Tileba Vleismark suits everyone from a family stocking up for the week to a restaurant or lodge sourcing meat on a wholesale basis.

Timber Maintenance grew out of Topdecks Creative Timbers and has spent the past decade offering preventative maintenance for wooden decks, windows, garage doors, balustrades, doors and pergolas around Wapadrand and the surrounding area. Depending on a structure's condition, the team applies a coat of oil, a light sand and reseal, or a full surface removal treatment, aiming to catch wear before it becomes costly damage.

The business works on a calendar system, scheduling different suburbs and areas on a roughly six-month cycle so that a client's timber gets its necessary treatment on time without them having to remember to book it. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, Timber Maintenance suits homeowners who would rather pay for scheduled upkeep than face a full replacement once neglected timber starts to rot or warp.

Titanium Link Group is a technology company in East Lynne, Pretoria, working across several specialised areas including data analytics, cybersecurity and radio and broadcasting systems. Its data analytics side covers data warehousing and data strategy work, while its cybersecurity team carries out vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and network security risk assessments for businesses wanting to understand their exposure before a breach occurs.

On the broadcasting side, the company designs, installs and supports radio and TV broadcasting systems and facilities, and its RF services cover fault management and finding, RF design and optimisation, and VSAT installation for clients needing reliable satellite or radio-frequency connectivity. Based in East Lynne, Titanium Link Group suits organisations needing a single technology partner across data, security and broadcast or RF infrastructure rather than separate specialist suppliers for each.
